fact: The ministry's list of WARDIP procurement contracts records Contract N°22/WARDIP/CI/2025, dated 23/07/2025, an individual-consultant assignment (IDA-financed, 4 months) for 'Assistance à la mise à niveau de l'Agenda national de Transformation Numérique et l'élaboration d'un Agenda 2030', so the 2030 agenda was still being elaborated, not adopted, at that date.
title: Marchés (liste des contrats WARDIP)
